## Cycle 6 — why not met

The deterministic code changes (#1 SVG normalization, #7 type-aware error label + 10 i18n updates, #17 MCP chip-only via shared helper) ARE correctly implemented in source and deployed in the bundle (verified via grep + live AC-17 probe). The Cycle 5 NONREG-TABLE fix remains intact at desktop+mobile.

HOWEVER, the BA spec's literal evidence requirements for AC-1, AC-7, AC-6, AC-14, AC-16, AC-18 (screenshots, console.warn captures, envelope sequence JSONs, raw permission payloads, Skill envelope captures) were NOT collected. Dev report explicitly defers these to QA ('Live UI verification at http://localhost:8097 ... deferred to QA'). QA could not produce them either: dev /dev/codex-render-fixtures route does not include a mermaid fixture; live dev sessions did not have in-flight Skill or AskUserQuestion content during the verification window; AC-18 historical Command replay requires Claude Code restart orchestration not feasible in QA cycle.

Per QA Anti-Fraud Principle 4 ('PASS requires evidence, not assertions'), and per Anti-Fraud Principle 5 ('Never substitute related-but-different verification'), the cycle does not meet the BA spec's full evidentiary contract. Source-side review + bundle deployment + live AC-17 probe + AC-NONREG checks are strong evidence for the code-change-shipped half; the live-runtime-evidence half is missing.

Codex adversarial review (gpt-5.5, xhigh, 145K tokens) confirmed the gap: 5 of 8 substantive points target evidence completeness (#3, #4, #5, #6, #7).
